decision: Approve the widened consumer-selected-condition convention for measurement conditions and position markers.

evidence.interpretation: The owner approved the exact naming widening in section 4 of the Pixel v0.1 plan. The whole-file plan SHA-256 is b16ee7519c291faf2bc3b0e2450bfaae39d09bb510d7de023920e28cc86c689b. Not native review authority.

semanticAmendments.boundary: Consumer-selected measurement conditions and position markers only; no automatic progress inference.

convention.name: state
convention.meaning: The consumer-selected interpretation of a measurement or position marker; values and domain are component-specific, independent of automatic thresholds.
convention.whenToUse: A component exposes a consumer-selected measurement condition or a position marker's condition, such as idle, past or active.
convention.avoid: Visual variants, material tone, loading behavior, automatic threshold inference or deriving a collection's progress.
